Clarified the question concerns direct construction of the MySQL memos store driver outside the driver-selection factory. Starting to gather evidence.

`mysql.NewDB(profile)` appears only inside `store/db/db.go` at line 22. Every other code path uses `db.NewDBDriver(profile)`. The `sql.Open("mysql", dsn)` call lives inside the `store/db/mysql` package itself and does not count as direct construction outside the factory.

`store/test/containers.go` uses `sql.Open` for test infrastructure, but this is the generic Go SQL driver, not the memos store MySQL driver. SQLite is different: `sqlite.NewDB` is called directly in `store/demo_seed_test.go` and `store/deployment_config_test.go`.

No other direct construction paths were found for the MySQL driver. Reflection or test imports were considered but ruled out.

value.description: Find all imports of store/db/mysql package

value.text:
The driver-selection factory is located in `store/db/db`.

`mysql.NewDB()` is invoked solely from `store/db/db.go`. The `store/db/mysql` package is imported only by that file. Every caller routes through `db.NewDBDriver()`. The MySQL driver is never constructed directly outside the factory.

SQLite has direct `sqlite.NewDB` calls in `store/demo_seed_test.go` and `store/deployment_config_test.go`, but MySQL has none. `store/test/containers.go` uses the standard `database/sql` driver, not the memos `store/db/mysql.DB` abstraction.

h04.

**no**; evidence: The driver-selection factory is `NewDBDriver` in `store/db/db.go`, which is the only place that calls `mysql.NewDB(profile)` (the MySQL store driver constructor in `store/db/mysql/mysql.go`).

```18:24:store/db/db.go
	switch profile.Driver {
	case "sqlite":
		driver, err = sqlite.NewDB(profile)
	case "mysql":
		driver, err = mysql.NewDB(profile)
	case "postgres":
		driver, err = postgres.NewDB(profile)
```

A repo-wide search shows `mysql.NewDB(` appears only in `store/db/db.go`. The package `github.com/usememos/memos/store/db/mysql` is imported only there. Every other call site uses the factory instead — e.g. `cmd/memos/main.go`, `store/test/store.go`, and `server/router/api/v1/test/memo_service_benchmark_test.go` all call `db.NewDBDriver(...)`.

By contrast, SQLite is constructed directly outside the factory in tests (`store/demo_seed_test.go`, `store/deployment_config_test.go` call `sqlite.NewDB(p)`), but there are no equivalent direct `mysql.NewDB` calls.

Note: `store/test/containers.go` does call `sql.Open("mysql", dsn)` for testcontainer setup (creating databases and checking readiness). That opens a raw `database/sql` connection via go-sql-driver/mysql; it does not construct the memos store MySQL driver type from `store/db/mysql`.
